summary.text: Elizabeth Jeanty is the Republican candidate for Florida State Senate District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Ashley Gantt in a race with no incumbent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a community educator, entrepreneur, nonprofit leader and media host.

paragraphs.text: Elizabeth Jeanty graduated from Miami Central Senior High School and has worked as a consultant.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born in the Dominican Republic to Haitian parents and has lived in South Florida a long time.
She said she has spent more than 20 years helping families access education, housing, immigration, tax, business and civic resources.
Jeanty said her campaign messages include housing costs, rising insurance premiums, small-business support and responsible use of taxpayer dollars.
She also named public safety, public education, health care access and flood resilience as policy interests.
